title: the verb and the tools
description: User story under REQ-186. `rcf define questions` and `rcf_define_questions` return the same object, so the CLI loop and the MCP loop cannot disagree.
iWant: the verb and the MCP tool to return the same object

acceptanceCriteria.description: [happy] given a failing tree, when rcf define questions --json runs, then stdout is the computeQuestions object and the exit code is 0.
[happy] given no --persona, when the verb runs on a profile whose register is engineer, then persona is engineer; with no profile it is productOwner.
[happy] given --stage skeleton and --limit 2, when the verb runs, then questions[] holds at most two D2 entries and remaining counts every D2 item.
[happy] given the MCP tool rcf_define_questions with the same arguments, when it is called, then structuredContent deep-equals the verb's --json output.
[failure] given --persona architect, when the verb runs, then it exits 2 with the usage line naming productOwner and engineer.
[must-not] given any invocation of rcf define questions, when it completes, then no file under rcf/ has been created or modified.
